3A.scope: Pairwise scatterplots, projected non-dominated marks, and dominance witnesses.

3B.scope: Scatterplot matrix, parallel coordinates, and the compact 3D reference on the same run records.

3C.scope: Frozen workloads, simulator, six heuristics, one DQN checkpoint, held-out runs, and paired summaries.

limits.energy: E sums task compute and transfer energy. Idle baseline electricity is excluded.
limits.dqn: One network, seed 8, and the online weights after episode 500. It is non-dominated in the full space on 1 of 36 held-out instances.
limits.participants: No external participants or domain experts. The checks cover computation, interaction consistency, and the tested simulator runs.
limits.external_validity: The topology has three edge nodes and one cloud node, tasks are synthetic and independent, and queues are FIFO.
